desc:
Remington tactical shotguns are rugged, ultra-dependable and continually evolve as they're called to serve in new, increasingly demanding environments.

Built on our legendary pump action that's become the gold standard for high-risk applications, the Model 870™ Express Tactical with a quick pointing 18 1/2" barrel and includes our extended ported Tactical Rem Choke. It packs a full 7 rounds of 2 3/4" or 3" 12-gauge firepower with the factory installed 2-shot extension.
